editedExercise.name: Arm Circles

instructions.description: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart. Extend your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, keeping your elbows fully extended.
Slowly rotate both arms forward, making small, controlled circles of approximately 1 foot (30 cm) in diameter. Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Gradually increase the size of the circles if comfortable, while keeping your arms extended and your posture upright.
Complete the designated number of repetitions or duration in one direction, then switch and rotate your arms backward. Keep the movement controlled throughout.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Arm Circles — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Start with small circles and gradually enlarge them.

While doing arm circles engage your core muscles, keep your back and your arms straight and maintain a smooth and deep breathing pattern. Keep your head up and your body in a T formation during the entire exercise.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them toward your ears.
Keep the movement smooth rather than using fast or jerky motions.
